subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on BMW engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the N63 across all 4 model applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The N63 is a V8 we work on across four BMW model lines — the 6 Series, 8 Series, X5 and X6 — across multiple generations spanning 2009 to the present.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Timing chain components, bearings, and the complete gasket and seal set as standard on every rebuild, with valve stem seals and cooling system components inspected and replaced where required.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: The N63's hot-vee design — turbochargers mounted inside the V between the cylinder banks — is a genuine platform characteristic that can contribute to heat-related component degradation over time. Valve stem seal leaks and timing chain stretch are documented wear patterns on this engine. Diagnosis is required to establish whether an engine needs repair, rebuild or replacement.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page - they'll be added once a documented set of completed N63 rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.
